comprimir-video.title: Compress Video
comprimir-video.description: Shrink a video's file size without uploading it anywhere. Free, right in your browser.
comprimir-video.cta: Need to compress video automatically inside your own platform? We can build that integration for you.
comprimir-video.seoTitle: Compress Video Free in Your Browser | SonhoLab
comprimir-video.seoDescription: Compress an MP4, WebM, or MOV video and choose the quality level. Free, no sign-up, and no upload: the compression happens right in your browser.
comprimir-video.intro: You don't always need to send a video at full quality. Sometimes it's just too heavy for WhatsApp or email. Here you pick a quality level and get a lighter MP4 in a few minutes, without the video ever leaving your computer or needing to install anything.
comprimir-video.step1Text: Drag the file into the box or click to browse your device. Works with the most common formats: MP4, WebM, and MOV.
comprimir-video.step2Text: Choose High, Medium, or Low depending on how much you need to shrink the file. The lower the quality, the smaller the file. But the loss of sharpness becomes more noticeable.
comprimir-video.step3Text: Click compress and wait for it to finish: how long it takes depends on the video's length and your device's power. When it's done, you'll see the original size next to the new one and can download the result.
comprimir-video.useCase1: Sending a phone-recorded video over WhatsApp when it's too large to send as-is.
comprimir-video.useCase2: Shrinking product or demo videos before uploading them to a website, so pages load faster.
comprimir-video.useCase3: Freeing up phone storage by compressing videos before backing them up.
comprimir-video.faq1q: Does my video get uploaded to a server to compress it?
comprimir-video.faq1a: No. The entire process happens inside your browser, using your own device's memory and processor. The file never travels to our servers or anyone else's, so no copy is ever stored anywhere else.
comprimir-video.faq2q: How long does it take to compress a video?
comprimir-video.faq2a: It depends on the video's length and how powerful your device is, since your device does all the work instead of a remote server. An older computer or phone will be noticeably slower than a modern computer, and long files can take several minutes.
comprimir-video.faq3q: Why is the first time I use this tool so much slower?
comprimir-video.faq3a: Because it needs to download a roughly 30MB video engine that lets it process the file inside your browser. That only happens once. After that, the engine is already there and later conversions start much faster.
comprimir-video.faq4q: What's the difference between High, Medium, and Low quality?
comprimir-video.faq4a: High keeps the most detail but shrinks the file less; Low gives you the smallest file, but there's a real, visible drop in sharpness, especially in fast-motion scenes. Medium is a reasonable middle ground for most videos.
comprimir-video.faq5q: Is it free? Do I need to create an account?
comprimir-video.faq5a: It's free, with no limit on how many videos you compress and no sign-up required. There's nothing to install either. It works in whatever browser you already have, on a computer or a phone.
